findings.round_2_evidence: Round-2 25-tacos-cart-after-add.png cart line now renders the full composition summary 'Merguez + Kefta + Cordon Bleu + Tenders · Sauce Ketchup/Mayonnaise · Sans oignon · + Œuf · 🍽 Menu · 🥤 Coca-Cola 33cl · 🧀 Cheddar fondu · 🍟 sauce Barbecue' (clamped to 2 lines with ellipsis + title=full text). DOM verified: line uses display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2. Total stable at 18,00 €. The bare '+ 1 suppléments' string is gone.

Round-2 31-terminator-step-recap.png now renders every step the user traversed: VIANDES (Kefta · Viande Hachée), SAUCE (Algérienne), CRUDITÉS (Toutes (Salade · Tomate · Oignon)), SUPPLÉMENTS (Aucun), FORMULE (Sans formule). 5 rows present, no silent omission.

Round-2 36-burger-step-recap.png renders SAUCE (Samouraï), CRUDITÉS (Toutes (Salade · Tomate · Oignon)), SUPPLÉMENTS (Aucun), FORMULE (Sans formule). Same fix as B-002 applied to burger template recap. No omission of default/none steps.

Round-2 04-cat-sandwichs.png — Le Terminator description '2 viandes au choix + 2 Cheddar + Œuf + Jambon de dinde' now wraps onto 2 lines fully visible. Le Cayenne description 'Viande hachée ou chicken + mozzarella + cheddar + crème fraîche' similarly wrapped. No hard right-edge clip.

Round-2 18-tacos-step-crudites.console.json is empty []. No React 'textDecoration / textDecorationColor shorthand conflict' warning. The strike-through Oignon chip renders cleanly in 18-tacos-step-crudites.png. ChoiceCard fix shipped.

The literal '+ 1 suppléments' string is no longer rendered (the entire composition line was replaced by the full summary — see B-001). DOM grep on 25-tacos-cart-after-add.dom.html for '1 suppléments' returns 0 matches. The pluralisation defect window is gone because the count-by-line phrase was abandoned.

Round-2 02-menu-screen.png + 04-cat-sandwichs.png + 10-cat-wings.png all still show product image-slots as flat black squares with the raw product name in low-contrast grey inset (Tacos M (1 Viande), Le Méga, Le Terminator, Ailes de poulet, Filets de poulet etc.). Console still warns '<image-slot> without an id' across pages. No real photography or emoji-tile fallback shipped.

Round-2 01-home-entry.png (and the equivalent 09-home-authed.png in Wave A) still shows the home featured Tacos XXL card with the dashed image-slot placeholder (image-glyph icon + caption 'Tacos XXL (4 Viandes)'). Same first-impression issue.

Round-2 19-tacos-step-supplements.png shows '+ 1,00 €' / '+ 0,50 €' subline still in a noticeably faded grey (~#9A8F7E-equivalent) on cream-white. Cluster-4 (visual quality) did not tweak this rule. Visual contrast looks marginally better than round-1 but still appears <4.5:1 — flagged as partial. axe-core verification still needed.

Round-2 20-tacos-step-menu.png shows '+3,00€' (no space) and '+2,00€' on the Menu/Frites/Boisson cards while 19-tacos-step-supplements.png shows '+ 1,00 €' (with spaces). Two formats still co-exist. DOM grep on 20-tacos-step-menu.dom.html confirms '+2,00€' and '+3,00€' literals.

Round-2 10-cat-wings.png shows the active 'Poulet Croustillant' chip centred but neighbour chips still hard-clipped ('S SALADES' on left, 'NOS M' on right). No fade gradient on edges. scrollIntoView centring observed for active chip but truncation on neighbours unchanged.

Round-2 25-tacos-cart-after-add.png subtitle still reads '1 article · prêt dans ~12 min'. The 'prêt dans ~12 min' static estimate is still hard-coded in DOM (no /api/cart/eta call in network.json). Loyalty preview '+18 pts gagnés' + '153 pts pour ton burger gratuit' also still mostly static.

Round-2 20-tacos-step-menu.dom.html now exposes role='radiogroup' and role='radio' on the wizard step inputs, and role='status' on at least one announcement region. However the dots-progression strip is not yet wrapped in role='progressbar'/aria-valuenow, and there's no explicit aria-live on step transitions confirming 'Étape 5 sur 9, Faire un menu'. Improvement but not full coverage.
